text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled release v2.3.1 to production queued for 03:00 UTC. STATUS: PAUSED because incident INC-2024-613 triggered in eu-west-1. Holding rollout until ops gives go. /cc @maria @kevin

maria (release-lead): copying. thanks. can we get a quick triage summary and a recommendation (rollback vs patch)?

kevin (eng-oncall): triage: noisy KV cache misses after db failover, CPU spikes on model-runtime hosts during canary. root cause looks infra-side (replica sync lag) but release amplifies it. Hotfix exists (reduce batch-size + disable prefix cache) — needs canary and quick verification.

sam (product): does the hotfix change behavior? any customer-visible diffs?

kevin (eng-oncall): minimal behavioral change — just resource configuration. No model output diffs. Should be transparent to customers.

nicole (infra): infra timeline: control plane will stabilize in ~30-45m if we stop additional pressure. If we rollback to the last stable image (v2.3.0 sha: abcd1234) we can reduce pressure immediately. We have automated migration guards so rollback is safe.

maria (release-lead): tradeoffs: rollback = fastest relief, but loses hotfix improvements. hotfix = targeted fix, but needs canary which risks further noise. preference?

kevin (eng-oncall): my recommendation: soft rollback traffic to v2.3.0 in prod for a 30m mitigation window, then reintroduce v2.3.1 with hotfix canary once DB replicas show steady replication. I can run the rollback steps and monitor.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-613 updated: state=investigating -> state=mitigating. Assigned to kevin. ETA to mitigation 40m.

maria (release-lead): agreed. Rolling back to pinned_version=v2.3.0 for now. Update release notes/announcements to reflect temporary rollback and that re-deploy will follow pending DB stabilization. @marketing FYI if we need customer comms later.

deploy-bot: Actions applied:
```
- release_state: paused
- pinned_version: v2.3.0
- rollback_trigger: manual_by_kevin
- scheduled_resume: null
- tags: [incident, rollback, emergency-window]
```

kevin (eng-oncall): running rollback now: `./deploy rollback --to abcd1234 --env prod --skip-migrations`

nicole (infra): watch groups: k8s/runtime-prod, db/eu-replica-set. I'll throttle canary ingress in the meantime.

maria (release-lead): noted. i'll update the internal release tracker and pause any post-release tasks. new tentative change window for re-deploy is +60m from now, will confirm.

sam (product): please add a brief note in the changelog about the temporary rollback and that no data migrations were reverted.

kevin (eng-oncall): rollback completed. Monitoring: latency dropped ~35%, KV miss rate down. Keeping monitoring for 15m before we consider reintroducing hotfix. :thumbsup:

maria (release-lead): thanks team. once db metrics look stable we'll schedule a controlled canary for the hotfix and I will open a small release window (canary-only) to validate.

ops-bot: Log entry: deployment action by kevin at 1715560600 - rollback to v2.3.0. Incident INC-2024-613 updated with mitigation steps.

maria (release-lead): action items:
- kevin: keep monitoring and post status in this thread (15m check)
- nicole: hold ingress throttles until metrics steady
- sam: prep changelog blurb + internal note
- deploy-bot: keep release paused and do not auto-resume

kevin (eng-oncall): 15m check: metrics stable. if no regression in next 10m i'll start hotfix canary in eu-west-1 with 2 pods.

maria (release-lead): copy. schedule for hotfix canary at 03:45 UTC if all clear. will update release tracker and set scheduled_resume=2024-03-12T03:45:00Z in the release metadata.

deploy-bot: release metadata updated: scheduled_resume=2024-03-12T03:45:00Z, paused=true, pinned_version=v2.3.0

maria (release-lead): closing loop — we paused the rollout, soft-rolled back to v2.3.0, and will attempt a hotfix canary in the adjusted window. will create a post-mortem once incident is resolved.

kevin (eng-oncall): acknowledged. will post final status after canary.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-613 note appended: mitigation = rollback + ingress throttle + hotfix canary.
